enabled.description: Set false to disable this stage. The deterministic and LLM scramblers are alternatives; enable at most one in a production pipeline.

expandContractions.description: Expand contractions (can't to cannot) so the contraction-form choice carries no bits. Fixed on: only true is accepted.

canonicalizeSynonyms.description: Map each word in a synonym ring to the ring's canonical member. Fixed on: only true is accepted.

passiveToActive.description: Rewrite simple passive-voice clauses to active voice. Fixed on: only true is accepted.
